1_split_integrity.split_provenance_explanation: Phase 3 and Phase 4.2 generated two different 5-fold group splits because the input column order passed to hash(tuple(row)) differed: Phase 3 used FEATURE_ORDER (BMI at index 20), whereas Phase 4.2/Phase 5 used raw CSV column order df.drop(columns=[TARGET_COL]) (BMI at index 3). The two test sets (50,737 vs 50,736 rows) are distinct 20% group partitions sharing 10,289 rows in common. The Phase 4.2 models were trained strictly on the 202,944 training rows of the raw-order split, and the Phase 5 final evaluation was evaluated strictly on the disjoint 50,736 test rows of that same split.
